Name: Give Anywhere
Author: maciel310
Description:
[size=2]This mod enables sending items to other farmhands, even if they're not nearby. Just select the item and press the key combination (see below), which will prompt you for which farmhand to give the item to.[/size]

[b][size=3]How to use[/size][/b]

The default keyboard combination is "[u]Ctrl + G[/u]" (G for Give) if you're using a keyboard, or "[u]BigButton + ControllerA[/u]" if you're using a controller. These key bindings can be changed in the mod's config.json file.


[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Tested with Stardew 1.6.15, though I believe it's likely compatible with older versions as well.

[size=3][b]Source Code
[/b][/size]
This mod is open source! You can find it on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/maciel310/sdv-give-anywhere]maciel310/sdv-give-anywhere[/url]
